acceptance.given: A Candidate Route was enabled for each Consumer in the frozen, complete Consumer Manifest; each applicable fixture has a bound Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category; no approved, bound applicability exception exists.

oracle.expected: For every applicable Consumer and fixture, the disable receipt records an actual Prior Route invocation and matches the bound Prior Route identity, baseline verdict, and diagnostic category.
forbidden: A missing Consumer or applicable fixture receipt.
A Candidate Route invocation during disable.
Any identity, verdict, or diagnostic-category mismatch from the Prior Behavior Baseline.
oracle.observable: Per-Consumer, per-fixture disable receipts emitted by the Toolchain replay entrypoint.

acceptance.then: Every applicable Consumer completes disable through the Prior Route with reproduced baseline identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.
acceptance.when: A disable transition is executed through each applicable real Consumer.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the disable-transition test with a Consumer adapter that changes route configuration without invoking the bound Prior Route; observe the required failing assertion before implementation.
Supply a disable receipt whose Prior Route identity, verdict, or diagnostic category differs from its bound baseline and require rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the Toolchain replay entrypoint so disable invokes the Prior Route through every applicable real Consumer and emits per-Consumer, per-fixture receipts bound to the Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category; reject configuration-only disable and any missing or mismatched reproduction.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Disable receipts are additive Toolchain evidence; rollback restores the prior replay-entrypoint behavior while preserving failed receipts and does not alter Phase, runtime, or Hosted state.

slice_hint.state_transition: Candidate Route enabled -> disable invokes Prior Route through every applicable Consumer -> per-fixture baseline reproduction recorded.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The disable transition succeeds only when every applicable Consumer receipt proves a real Prior Route invocation and exact reproduction of the bound Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category for every applicable fixture.
